card.name: Spots right before overflow or overload words
card.fires_on: Responds to the spot just before a word like overflow, overload or overdose could come. It marks commas in lists of pump alarms, 'Over' in 'Opioid Overdose', and words after 'reset' or 'PPTC device'.
